criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks general facts, descriptions, or broad information about COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms and Health Impact
categories.definition: User asks about symptoms, health effects, or personal health status related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: User asks about how COVID-19 spreads or general measures to prevent infection.

categories.name: Treatment and Vaccine
categories.definition: User asks about treatments, cures, or vaccines for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics and Updates
categories.definition: User requests current statistics, news, or general updates about COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel and Location-Specific Restrictions/Risks
categories.definition: User asks about travel safety, restrictions, or risk levels related to COVID-19 in specific locations.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation Debunking
categories.definition: User asks to confirm or debunk a specific myth or false claim about COVID-19.

categories.name: Animal-Related Concerns
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19 transmission to or from animals, or its impact on them.

categories.name: Object/Surface-Related Concerns
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19 survival or transmission via objects and surfaces, including cleaning practices for them.

categories.name: Personal Guidance/Risk Assessment
categories.definition: User seeks advice or assessment for a personal situation or specific scenario related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Bot Interaction/Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses greetings, thanks, or general acknowledgement to the bot.

categories.name: Sharing Content/Functionality
categories.definition: User requests to share information, links, or the bot's functionality.

categories.name: Donation/Support Requests
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate or asks how to support COVID-19 relief efforts.
